title: Duplicate loyalty points after checkout retry
incident_report: Customers using a loyalty coupon are occasionally receiving loyalty points twice after checkout retries. It seems to happen when the payment response is slow and the cashier submits the checkout a second time.
symptoms: occurs after a checkout is submitted again
a second transaction is created for the same cart
expected_root_cause: checkout is missing an idempotency guard for an already completed cart, so a retry re-runs completion and awards loyalty a second time

mutations.replace: // idempotency guard removed: retries now re-run completion
